sq.q: \(\text{Define Fourier cosine and sine transforms and their inverses.}\)
answer: \(\text{Fourier cosine transform: } F_c(s) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \cos(s x) dx\)
\(\text{Fourier sine transform: } F_s(s) = \sqrt{\frac{2}{\pi}} \int_{0}^{\infty} f(x) \sin(s x) dx\)
